title: Patrol Y61 (GU)
subtitle: Nissan Patrol · 1997–2016
specs: TB45E 4.5 petrol · RD28ETi 2.8 TD · TD42 4.2 D · TD42T
buy: TD42T turbo-diesel added (to the ST in Australia)
avoid: GU II (April): 3.0 L four-cylinder ZD30DDTi diesel arrives with an optional automatic
checks: Identify the engine and series first
ZD30: demand oil history and check the dipstick
Rear axle seals, diffs and underbody
owner: The GU is the Patrol that kept the solid axles and coils of the GQ, added a squarer body and spent nineteen years in Australian showrooms.
